## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical supply chain security knowledge at a beginner level, focusing on concrete tooling (cosign, Sigstore), per-tenant isolation, and IR readiness.

## Key Concepts
- Image signing and provenance with cosign/Sigstore
- Per-tenant registries and image provenance policies
- CI secret scanning and SBOM generation
- Short-lived credentials for runners and secure secret handling

## Code Example
```yaml
name: Verify image provenance
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  verify-image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up cosign
        run: |
          curl -sSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sigstore/cosign/v1.6.0/cosign-linux-amd64 -o cosign
          chmod +x cosign
      - name: Verify image provenance
        run: |
          ./cosign verify ghcr.io/tenant/registry/service:latest --certificate cosign.pub
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you roll this out to 100 tenants with minimal ops? 
- What metrics and dashboards would you use to detect tampering early?

## Why This Is Asked

  permissions: ['read'],
  ttl: 3600 // 1 hour
}, { spiIdentity: clientSPIFFE });
```

deny[msg] {
  input.review.kind.kind == "Pod"
  image := input.review.object.spec.containers[_].image
  not verified_image[image]
  msg := sprintf("Image '%v' is not signed or lacks a valid SBOM", [image])
}

verified_image[image] {
  cosign.verify(image)
  sbom_exists(image)
}

sbom_exists(image) {
  input.review.object.metadata.annotations["sbom.id"]
}
```
